name: aspira-kit
description: The Aspira Labs development kit: ui, config, and the kit CLI. One repo, one version, every project.

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @aspiralabs/ui test && node packages/ui/scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../.packs
